biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle. Due to the massacre at Balmamusa he broke his ties with the Resistance and went into hiding with Catiua.
  In battle with Sir Leonar he learned the Duke planned to forge a secret treaty with the Dark Knights Loslorien. He set off for Rhime to stop the proceedings, but before he could act the duke was killed through Vyce's treachery. With the Resistance rudderless he offered to take the helm, and he now commands all of southern Valeria.
biography_spanish:
Walister oriundo de Golyat que lidera la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica. Debido a la matanza de Balmamusa rompio lazos con la Resistencia y se escondio con Catiua.                                 .
  Tras luchar con sir Leonar descubrio que el duque planeaba un tratado secreto con los Caballeros Oscuros de Loslorien. Partio hacia Rhime para detenerlo, pero antes de actuar el duque murio tras la traicion de Vyce. Sin lider en la Resistencia, tomo el mando y ahora lidera todo el sur de Valeria.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa.
  Upon ousting Sir Leonar, who had slain the Duke over doubts about his fitness to lead, he took control of the Resistance. He also made peace with Vyce's New Walister Alliance, demonstrating a caliber of leadership beyond his years.
biography_spanish:
Walister de Golyat al mando de la Orden de {order}. Se unio a la Resistencia tras liberar al duque Ronwey del castillo Almorica y luego participo en la matanza de Balmamusa.                                
  Al derrocar a sir Leonar, quien mato al duque al dudar de su capacidad de liderazgo, asumio el mando de la Resistencia. Hizo la paz con la Nueva Alianza Walister de Vyce, mostrando una gran madurez para liderar a su edad.

biography_english:
A Walister hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa. Despite setbacks he eventually came to lead the Resistance against the Bakram and Dark Knight forces.
  His people call him the "Hero of Golyat," and have faith that he can put an end to the ravages of war.

biography_english:
A Bakram hailing from Golyat who leads the Order of {order}. He joined the Resistance after freeing Duke Ronwey from his imprisonment at Almorica Castle, and later took part in the massacre at Balmamusa. Despite setbacks he eventually came to lead the Resistance against the Bakram and Dark Knight forces.
  He was reunited with his father, Prancet, at Brigantys Castle, and from him learned the truth of Catiua's past. Olivya also revealed he was actually born in Heim of Bakram descent, with his father the brother of Regent Brantyn Morne. He now seeks to destroy the Dark Knights to fulfill his father's dying wish.
